description: Encelade lets you plan, generate, personalize, find, rename, restyle, and delete presentation decks from ChatGPT. Create a complete deck from a topic and outline, adapt an existing template for a customer, and preview slides before opening the deck in Encelade. You can also create and update reusable workspace themes with brand colors, fonts, and a company logo.

defaultPrompt: Create a six-slide sales deck for retail executives about reducing inventory waste.
Plan a ten-slide investor deck about grid-scale battery storage, but don't generate it yet.
Show me my five most recently updated presentation decks.
